memory_update.text: Highest-priority direct public candidates for uranium_conversion_enrichment_haleu are LEU, CCJ, BWXT, HON, and GEV; each has evidence tied to enrichment, conversion, HALEU feedstock, deconversion, or fuel fabrication.
UEC, UUUU, NXE, and DNN are upstream uranium feedstock candidates; include them in the universe, but separate them from the tighter HALEU/enrichment/conversion chokepoint.
Honeywell is important to map despite low stock purity because Honeywell Metropolis Works is identified by ConverDyn as the only US UF6 conversion facility.
Cameco is a multi-node nuclear fuel-cycle candidate because of uranium mining, conversion services, Westinghouse ownership, and Global Laser Enrichment exposure.

Major fuel-cycle entities Orano, Framatome, Urenco, Westinghouse, General Atomics, TerraPower, and General Matter are not clean standalone US-listed equities; map them through owners, partners, customers, and contract recipients.
ASPI, LTBR, NNE, and OKLO require stricter evidence-gating because much of their fuel-cycle exposure is developmental, customer-side, or dependent on licensing and future commercialization.

Next evidence layer should verify DOE HALEU enrichment task orders dated January 5, 2026, DOE deconversion task orders, NRC license scopes, and actual production/delivery milestones rather than relying only on eligibility awards.

node: Uranium mining, conversion, enrichment, deconversion, HALEU, and nuclear fuel fabrication
summary: Expanded US-listed universe for the nuclear fuel-cycle node. The highest-relevance chokepoint candidates are direct fuel-cycle participants in enrichment, conversion, HALEU processing, deconversion, and fuel fabrication: Centrus, Cameco, BWX Technologies, Honeywell, GE Vernova, and Brookfield-linked Westinghouse exposure. Uranium miners and developers provide upstream feedstock leverage but may be less scarce than conversion/enrichment/HALEU in some advanced-reactor scenarios. Advanced-reactor developers and fuel-technology companies are included only where they create direct HALEU demand, fuel-recycling plans, transport systems, or alternative fuel IP. This is research support only, not a trading recommendation.
